payload.text: Firstsource | Intelligence That Operates Contact us Intelligence is everywhere. Accountability isn't. We design, build, and run AI-native operations for the world's most demanding industries, and stand behind the outcomes. See how it works Report HFS Non-Linearity Index REPORT Firstsource Annual Report FY2025-2026 Partnership Firstsource and Cresta Partner to Transform CX with AI Podcast Ritesh Idnani Speaks with Phil Fersht of HFS Research A new kind of partner The full-stack intelligence operator The old model hands you off: one firm writes the strategy, another builds the tech, a third runs the work. Accountability falls through the gaps, and outcomes falter. We're built differently. One team that does all three, under one contract, and owns the outcome. Transform We rethink the operation Built for the agentic era: a fresh operating model, workforce, and commercial construct - not bolted onto the old playbook. IMPLEMENT We build the intelligence in Decision engines and agentic systems wired into your stack — production systems, not pilots or slideware. OPERATE We run it and own the result A human-plus-AI workforce running the work to the numbers we stand behind, getting smarter with every decision. One team. One contract. One continuous motion . Strategy, build, and run aren't handled between vendors — they're one accountable team. That's what turns AI capability into enterprise value: a single owner for the outcome. Yours, with us. WHAT MAKES IT REAL Intelligence That Operates Domain intelligence Hard-won knowledge of the world's most demanding industries, encoded as decision logic that handles the edge cases. Full-stack delivery Design, build, and run agentic operations under one roof, under one contract. Compounding intelligence The longer we operate, the smarter the foundation gets — every engagement compounds. Outcome accountability We don't just deliver outcomes — we underwrite them. Revenue tied to results, not inputs. Governed autonomy Trust isn't assumed, it's architected — governance built into every system, earned through performance.
